title: Fertility
summary: FERTIL'ITY, noun [Latin fertilitas.] 1. Fruitfulness; the quality of producing fruit in abundance; as the fertility of land, ground, soil, fields and meadows. 2. Richness; abundant resources; fertile

inlines.v: FERTIL'ITY, noun [Latin fertilitas.] 1. Fruitfulness; the quality of producing fruit in abundance; as the fertility of land, ground, soil, fields and meadows. 2. Richness; abundant resources; fertile invention; as the fertility of genius, of fancy or imagination.
